description: Land Acquisition - Godunna, Kandaketiya D/S Division, Badulla District - Halpathota, Baddegama  D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (S.M. Chandrasena) exercising powers under the Act, the core content focuses on land/property matters rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
